body:
Q5 PRIMARY-SOURCE PREP — ADVISORY ONLY, not a bead claim or final licence disposition. OSF/chief retain ownership. I accepted no terms, created no accounts/tokens, downloaded no artifacts, selected no model, and touched no repo path.

The key split is code vs weights vs upstream data/features:

| Component | Evidence-based disposition | Exact reason / official source |
|---|---|---|
| TransNetV2 | usable as-is | MIT repository; inference assets live in the same licensed repo; no account gate. https://github.com/soCzech/TransNetV2 and /blob/master/LICENSE |
| OpenAI Whisper + faster-whisper | usable as-is for ASR | OpenAI explicitly says code AND model weights are MIT; Systran code and converted large-v3 model card are MIT and public. https://github.com/openai/whisper ; https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper ; https://huggingface.co/Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3 |
| WhisperX | code usable; full bundle not yet admissible | WhisperX code is BSD-2-Clause, but word timing auto-selects a language-specific torchaudio/HF wav2vec alignment model. Pin and disposition that exact model before enabling alignment. Diarization is the separate gated pyannote row below. https://github.com/m-bain/whisperX |
| pyannote community-1 | OWNER MUST ACCEPT | Model is CC-BY-4.0 but access explicitly requires sharing contact information, accepting user conditions, and creating an HF token. Agents must not accept on owner’s behalf. https://huggingface.co/pyannote/speaker-diarization-community-1 |
| Qwen2.5-VL / InternVL3 | usable as-is on licence/access only | Official public model cards are Apache-2.0 and not gated. This says nothing about capability, calibration, compute, or which model to select. https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct ; https://huggingface.co/OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B-Instruct |
| Vid2Seq | code usable; drop stock weights until explicit terms bind them | Scenic code is Apache-2.0 and official checkpoints are public GCS links, but the README does not state separate checkpoint terms. A repo code licence is not proof for externally hosted weights. https://github.com/google-research/scenic/tree/main/scenic/projects/vid2seq |
| ActionFormer / TriDet | code usable; drop stock artifacts until separately dispositioned | Both codebases are MIT, but pretrained checkpoints are external Google Drive files and pipelines depend on separately sourced dataset-derived features/annotations. No explicit checkpoint licence was found on the official pages. https://github.com/happyharrycn/actionformer_release ; https://github.com/dingfengshi/TriDet |
| V-JEPA 2 | usable as-is | Official HF checkpoint card is Apache-2.0 and public; repo code is mostly MIT with three Apache-2.0 files. https://huggingface.co/facebook/vjepa2-vitg-fpc64-384 ; https://github.com/facebookresearch/vjepa2 |
| VideoMAE V2 | drop as a general default; research-only policy decision | Code is MIT, but the official giant checkpoint card is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Noncommercial weights should not silently become a general library default. https://github.com/OpenGVLab/VideoMAEv2 ; https://huggingface.co/OpenGVLab/VideoMAEv2-giant |
| SlowFast | code usable; hold stock weights pending explicit weight terms | Code is Apache-2.0 and the model zoo is public, but the official page does not separately state checkpoint terms; dataset rights remain separate. https://github.com/facebookresearch/SlowFast |
| SAM 2 | usable as-is | Official README explicitly states model checkpoints, demo code, and training code are Apache-2.0; downloads are public. https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam2 |
| “re-identification” | drop/unresolved until a concrete model is named | A capability label is not a licensable artifact. Select an exact repo + weights + training-data provenance before admission. SAM 2 supplies tracking masks, not re-ID identity semantics by itself. |

Proposed minimal Q5 closure: adopt the clear usable rows; owner accepts pyannote conditions only if diarization is wanted; keep WhisperX alignment model-specific; reject/hold Vid2Seq, ActionFormer/TriDet stock artifacts, SlowFast stock weights, VideoMAEv2 default weights, and unspecified re-ID until their exact artifact terms are recorded. This is a provenance/access disposition, not legal advice and not adapter authorization.
